judgment.rationale: The choppy Find My Mouse spotlight is visually demonstrated and acknowledged by a maintainer, but the thread lacks current-version, refresh-rate, display topology, and diagnostic details needed to separate expected animation smoothing from a performance defect.
evidence: The reporter attached a comparison video showing Find My Mouse lagging behind the pointer while Mouse Highlighter remains smooth.
A maintainer acknowledged the performance concern.
A later user says the issue is especially visible on a 240 Hz monitor.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable performance reproduction with display refresh rate, monitor topology, and graphics details.

fix_assessment.rationale: The symptom is credible, but the rendering/performance boundary is not sufficiently characterized for a grounded fix.

issue_context.summary: Find My Mouse's spotlight visibly trails or updates choppily compared with Mouse Highlighter, especially on high-refresh displays.
known_information: A public video demonstrates the difference.
Both single- and multi-monitor users report the symptom.
A 240 Hz display makes it more noticeable.
inferences: The spotlight update cadence may not scale with high refresh rates, but this has not been measured.
issue_context.analysis: A compact current environment report will make a later performance design testable.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Current PowerToys version, refresh rate, monitor count, and GPU.
information_gaps.why_needed: These parameters can materially affect animation cadence.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest on current stable and list the display/GPU configuration.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic report during a reproduced session.
information_gaps.why_needed: It provides the rendering environment and module logs.

actions.label: Request current spotlight performance evidence
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Please retest Find My Mouse on the current stable PowerToys release and share the monitor count, refresh rate(s), scaling, GPU, and whether HDR or variable refresh rate is enabled. A short comparison recording against Mouse Highlighter plus a `/bugreport` captured after the test would make the performance target measurable.
